Morbstack host docker-compose CLI plugin provenance
=====================================================

File: docker-compose
Source: https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/v5.3.1/docker-compose-darwin-aarch64
Release: docker/compose v5.3.1 (latest release at time of fetch)
Platform: darwin-aarch64 (host Mac, arm64 — this is a host CLI plugin
          binary, not a guest asset; it never enters the VM/initramfs)
sha256: 32691ba1196d819fa68cbdc0aad9a5569e730a35ae40c6fdd8458110ecd69488

Verification: sha256 fetched from GitHub Release's own per-asset sidecar
file (docker-compose-darwin-aarch64.sha256, published alongside the
binary in the same release) and matched the locally computed hash
exactly.

`file` confirms: Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64. Runs standalone
(`./docker-compose version` -> "Docker Compose version v5.3.1") on this
host without needing `docker` on PATH first.

Purpose: gate G4 (`docker compose up -d` via the standard compose CLI
plugin) needs the `docker compose` subcommand, which the docker CLI
resolves via its cli-plugins mechanism. This binary is fetched and cached
here so the repo doesn't depend on the user having Docker Desktop (which
normally ships its own copy) — but it is NOT installed into
~/.docker/cli-plugins/ by this repo's tooling. Per task instructions, do
not touch the user's dotfiles; the docs should tell users to symlink it
themselves:
  mkdir -p ~/.docker/cli-plugins
  ln -sf "$(pwd)/dist/host-bin/docker-compose" ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose

Fetched by scripts/fetch-guest-assets.sh (--compose-only).
